interpretation_notes: All values are calculated from the synthetic project datasets.
Order-level on-time rate over all orders includes carrier-unavailable orders in the denominator; completed-only rate excludes them.
Carrier performance is shipment-level, not order-level.
Warehouse utilization is weighted across node-days present in capacity_usage.csv.
Ground-truth anomaly labels are seeded test cases, not predictions from an anomaly detector.
Precision, recall, F1 and detection accuracy are intentionally not reported because no detector predictions have been evaluated against the labels.
